'''Turun Palloseura''', commonly known as '''TPS''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Turku]], Finland. Since winning promotion in 2025, the men's team competes in [[Veikkausliiga]], the highest tier. Nicknamed "''Tepsi''", the club was founded in 1922.<ref name=TPS />

TPS have won eight [[List of Finnish football champions#Performance by club|League titles]] and three [[Finnish Cup]]s.<ref name=TPS>{{cite web|url=https://fc.tps.fi/fi/seura/historia|title=Seura {{!}} Historia|language=fi|access-date=11 May 2018|work=Official website of Turun Palloseura|archive-date=25 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025113734/https://fc.tps.fi/fi/seura/historia|url-status=live}}</ref> They play their home league matches at [[Veritas Stadion]], with a capacity of 9,372 seats for most matches.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://fc.tps.fi/fi/uutiset/tps-n-kotiavaus-siirtyy-perjantaille-20-5 |title=TPS News |date=12 April 2016 |publisher=fc.tps.fi |access-date=2016-04-12 |archive-date=2017-08-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170827130241/https://fc.tps.fi/fi/uutiset/tps-n-kotiavaus-siirtyy-perjantaille-20-5 |url-status=live }}</ref>"}}
